query: Which mixed-mode survey administration strategies (online, paper, interviewer-assisted) most effectively include older workers with sensory or cognitive limits?

response.query: Which mixed-mode survey administration strategies (online, paper, interviewer-assisted) most effectively include older workers with sensory or cognitive limits?
response.answer: Online surveys with interviewer assistance most effectively include older workers with sensory or cognitive limits. Flexibility in pacing and personalized support improve response rates. Tailored instructions and follow-up help ensure inclusivity.

results.title: (PDF) Methodological considerations in surveys of older adults
results.content: This paper reviews the literature on the methodological issues inherent in surveying older adults, and analyzes data collected in a large telephone survey.
